channel.title: Microsoft Customer Stories (unofficial)
channel.description: Unofficial feed of Microsoft customer success stories.

item.title: Planet DDS cuts provisioning time from six weeks to one day with Azure modernization
item.description: Industry: Healthcare — “Having a multi-vendor environment sounds great on paper, but in practice, it fragments operations. With Azure, we can deliver the performance, resilience, and security our enterprise customers expect without the complexity of managing it ourselves.”

item.title: Peterborough Regional Health Centre turns fragmented data into trusted insight
item.description: Industry: Healthcare — “We started fairly simple by embedding Copilot on top of our analytics, letting people ask natural language questions of the data, and helping clinicians get curious without having to go learn how to code. This early work helped staff engage with data in a more accessible way while maintaining trust.”

item.title: City of Raleigh to save commuters an estimated $9.7 million with digital twins and Microsoft Azure
item.description: Industry: Government — “In 2025, we had an opportunity to partner with Microsoft, NVIDIA and Esri to integrate our data into a digital twin, which creates a virtual environment of our city where we can visualize and potentially analyze scenarios.”

item.title: Accenture achieves 30% faster investigations with Microsoft Defender XDR
item.description: Industry: Professional and Business Services — “Deploying the Defender suite delivered more advanced XDR and incident prioritization. As we’ve increased the data flowing through Defender XDR, we’ve become more effective with automation and triage—and faster in how we respond.”

item.title: NTT DATA strengthens customer touchpoints with a secure AI agent using Microsoft Defender
item.description: Industry: Telecommunications and Media — “Generative AI is gaining in momentum from general users on up. There is a crucial caveat: AI introduces new risks and threats not found in conventional IT systems. Solutions like Customer Service AI Agent prioritize security from the outset based on Secure by Design principles (strategies ensuring information security from planning/design stages).”
item.category: Content Safety in Foundry Control Plane
Microsoft Defender Cloud Security Posture Management

item.title: Duke Health builds digital resilience for Epic EHR with disaster recovery on Azure
item.description: Industry: Healthcare — “IT systems are deeply embedded in clinical workflows, and when they go down, the risk of error rises. What keeps me up at night isn’t a server outage—it’s the possibility of a clinician having to make critical decisions without the full picture in front of them.”

item.title: Krones cuts simulation run times by up to 98% with AI agents and Azure High-Performance Computing
item.description: Industry: Industrials and Manufacturing — “It was an outstanding experience on how quickly things can run with the right partners.”

item.title: Brown Health scales Microsoft Dragon Copilot and AI agents to ease care delivery
item.description: Industry: Healthcare — “Now, I can focus on what I think is going on with you and hearing you and being with you. The documentation is happening in parallel with engagement with the patient.”

item.title: Smart sales with AI: Rhenus banks on Dynamics 365 to enable more focus on customers
item.description: Industry: Automotive, Mobility, and Transportation — “With Dynamics 365, we not only modernized our processes—we set a new direction for our customer strategy. With Dynamics 365, we established a platform that, in the technical sphere, reflects our group-wide sales standards.”

item.title: NHS Scotland delivers a higher standard of cancer care using Microsoft Power Platform
item.description: Industry: Healthcare — “We were able to customize our MDT solution with Power Platform in a way that instantly resonated with our users.”

item.title: GN Store Nord insources global supply chain with Dynamics 365 Warehouse Only Mode
item.description: Industry: Healthcare — “Warehouse Only Mode helped shift GN from an ERP-centric warehouse setup to a modular platform model. It has strengthened control, improved scalability, and created a stronger foundation for future automation, innovation, and operational change.”

item.title: Central Coast Council serves 355,000 citizens anytime, anywhere with Surface 5G
item.description: Industry: Government — “With Copilot and Surface devices, workers in the field can search through a 300-page document in seconds, find the most efficient way to fix a water main break, and complete it within the mandated 4-hour timeframe.”

item.title: Kawasaki builds scalable robotics as a service platform with Azure Kubernetes Service
item.description: Industry: Industrials and Manufacturing — “Azure Kubernetes Service gave us a consistent platform for deploying robotics applications across environments. Instead of rebuilding software for each implementation, we can develop capabilities once and scale them across deployments.”

item.title: Kooperativa saves thousands of hours annually with Azure-based chatbots
item.description: Industry: Financial Services — “We’re now using AI agents to carry out complex activities that save us days per week in manual effort.”

item.title: Stadt Rosenheim modernizes operations and strengthens governance with Microsoft 365
item.description: Industry: Government — “A modern workplace is a foundational building block for us. It’s what allows us to become more digital and data-driven, while still ensuring governance, sovereignty, and long-term control over our IT landscape.”

item.title: Astellas explores hundreds of protein mutations with BioEmu in Microsoft Foundry
item.description: Industry: Healthcare — “Collaborating with Microsoft researchers helped us quickly carry out the proof of concept and evaluate the technology correctly.”

item.title: How EY and Xoople bring geospatial intelligence into enterprise decision-making
item.description: Industry: Retail and Consumer Goods — “By combining EY’s supply chain expertise, Xoople’s geospatial intelligence, and Microsoft technologies including Planetary Computer Pro, Fabric, and Foundry, we are helping clients bring physical-world signals directly into enterprise planning workflows and make faster, more informed operational decisions.”

item.title: Transforming comptrollership: PSC cuts travel email inquiries by 90% using M365 Copilot agent

By connecting staff to approved, cited information in seconds, we’re improving consistency, reducing reliance on informal advice and building confidence in how AI can support our workforce today and into the future.”

Together with Microsoft, we’re building an AI foundation that helps AGCO move faster, reduce friction, and equip our teams to make better decisions for the farmers and customers we serve.”

item.title: Storebrand builds a multi-region cloud foundation to strengthen operational resilience with Azure

item.title: Medicana builds a bespoke patient experience solution on Microsoft Power Platform

By connecting people, omnichannel engagement, real-time data, and AI-driven insights, we deliver a more seamless and personalized mobility experience for clients, employees, and Sirva teams.”

item.title: Building the intelligence foundation for the energy transition

item.title: Azure VMware Solution helps the State of Alaska migrate 1,100+ apps in 21 months
